a.say: Psst. If I yip my name, will it yip back? Let's try.

choices.label: Try it!
choices.reply: Sly-y-yte! …Slyte! It said my name! It KNOWS me.

choices.label: Say mine!
choices.reply: {child}! …{child}! It knows you too!

b.say: The hill is very good at names. Better than me. I say "um" a lot.

a.say: The snail and I are having a race. I'm letting it win.

b.say: Is that okay? It's very far behind.

choices.label: @pool:yes
choices.reply: Phew. Go, snail! You can do it! Slowly!

choices.label: Slow is fine
choices.reply: Slow IS fine. I'll go slow too. (Takes one step.) Whew.

choices.label: @pool:giggle
choices.reply: It's funny, right? I'm winning by losing. Ha!

a.say: Which rainbow color is the best one?

choices.label: Purple
choices.reply: Purple! Berry color. My nose agrees.

choices.label: Red
choices.reply: Red! Like a ladybug. Like a happy face.

choices.label: All of them
choices.reply: All of them. Of course. A rainbow needs its whole team.

b.say: I'd be orange. Fox orange. Wait— I already am. I'm part rainbow!

c.say: {pet_phrase} Slyte: one-seventh rainbow. Official.

a.say: Psst. Let's play bakery. I'm the baker. One pretend cake.

b.say: What kind of cake would you like?

choices.label: Honey cake
choices.reply: One honey cake! (Hands over nothing.) Careful. It's very sticky.

choices.label: Berry cake
choices.reply: Berry cake! Out of berries. I ate them. Pretend I didn't.

choices.label: A giant cake
choices.reply: A giant cake! (Stretches arms wide.) This big. Good?

c.say: Is it yummy?

choices.label: Yummy!
choices.reply: Yay! Best baker in the treehouse. Only baker, too.

choices.label: Too sticky!
choices.reply: Too sticky? Pretend napkin! (Pats your hand.) There.

choices.label: @pool:giggle
choices.reply: You're giggling with your mouth full! Pretend full.

a.say: I'm practicing pebble skipping. On the puddle. Listen!

b.say: (Plip.) …It went in. Straight in. Zero skips.

c.say: Is zero skips still a skip?

choices.label: Totally!
choices.reply: I knew it! Zero skips. A record.

choices.label: Not really
choices.reply: Hmm. Then it was a pebble bath. Also good.

choices.label: @pool:unsure
choices.reply: A mystery skip. My favorite kind.

a.say: My ears just flipped inside out. The wind did it.

b.say: Do my ears look funny?

choices.label: A little!
choices.reply: Ha! I'll keep them like this. Fashion.

choices.label: Super cute
choices.reply: Super cute? (Ears flip back.) Oops. Still cute?

c.say: {pet_phrase} Wind is the best hairdresser. It never asks first though.

a.say: Psst. My treehouse needs a sign. What should it say?

choices.label: Berries inside
choices.reply: "Berries inside." Very true. Sometimes.
choices.memory: We made a treehouse sign: Berries inside

choices.label: Everyone welcome
choices.reply: "Everyone welcome." Even beetles. Even wind.
choices.memory: We made a treehouse sign: Everyone welcome

choices.label: Slyte's house
choices.reply: "Slyte's house." So people know it's me.
choices.memory: We made a treehouse sign: Slyte's house

b.say: (Scratches letters with a stick.) Done. Mostly done. It's a squiggle.

c.say: It says {var:treeSign}. If you read squiggle.

a.say: It's a little chilly. Good thing I brought my scarf.

b.say: Want to see my scarf?

choices.label: @pool:yes
choices.reply: (Wraps its tail around its neck.) Ta-da. Tail scarf.

choices.label: What scarf?
choices.reply: This scarf! (Wraps its tail around.) Built in.

c.say: Tail scarves are the best. You never forget them at home.

a.say: Snow! My paw prints are in it. Look. A paw path.

b.say: Should I make a circle or a line?

choices.label: A circle!
choices.reply: (Hops in a circle.) Round paw path. I'm dizzy. Good dizzy.

choices.label: A line
choices.reply: (Hops in a line.) Straight to… nowhere. Very straight.

choices.label: Write your name
choices.reply: (Hops carefully.) S… L… hmm, an S. Good start.

a.say: Okay okay okay. I put a flower on my ear. One flower.

b.say: How does it look?

choices.label: Pretty!
choices.reply: Pretty! I feel pretty. Fancy Slyte. Very {word:shiny}.

choices.label: Silly!
choices.reply: Silly! Good. Silly is my best look.

choices.label: Add more!
choices.reply: More? (Adds three.) Now I'm a garden. Hello, bees!

a.say: I found a very long stick. What should we do with it?

choices.label: Draw in the dirt
choices.reply: (Draws.) A circle. With ears. It's me. Obviously.

choices.label: Pretend fishing
choices.reply: Fishing for… leaves! (Swish.) Caught one!

choices.label: Tap a tree
choices.reply: (Tok-tok.) The tree is a drum now. Tree band!

b.say: Sticks can be anything. That's why I keep so many.

a.say: Psst. There's a star. The first one. Do you make a wish?

b.say: What would a Slyte wish for?

choices.label: Berries
choices.reply: Infinite berries! Okay that's greedy. One nice berry.

choices.label: Jumping higher
choices.reply: Higher jumps! Moon-high. Fwip! …Maybe one day.

choices.label: A friend
choices.reply: Oh. I already have one. So I'll wish for you a good day.

a.say: Let's make faces in the window glass. I'll go first.

b.say: (Squishes its nose flat.) …That's my snout face.

c.say: Your turn! What face?

choices.label: Silly face
choices.reply: (Gasps.) That's the best silly face. You win.

choices.label: Grumpy face
choices.reply: A grumpy face! (Tries.) …I can't. I keep smiling.

choices.label: Surprised face
choices.reply: (Ears straight up.) Like THIS? We're twins.

d.say: Window faces. A new game. Not a contest. Okay, a tiny contest.

a.say: The ant dropped its crumb. Should I help?

b.say: What should I do?

choices.label: Nose it back
choices.reply: (Nudges the crumb.) Gently… there. You're welcome, ant.

choices.label: Let it try
choices.reply: Okay. It's trying. It's doing it! Go, ant, go!

choices.label: Give a bigger crumb
choices.reply: A bigger crumb! Too big. Now it's an ant mountain.

a.say: Hic. Okay, I'm holding my breath. (Puffs out cheeks.)

b.say: …Hic! It snuck past. Sneaky hiccups.

c.say: What should I try now?

choices.label: Upside down
choices.reply: (Tries.) …Hic. Upside-down hic. That's new.

choices.label: Hop like a frog
choices.reply: (Hops.) Hop, hop. …Hey! Gone! Frog cure!

choices.label: @pool:giggle
choices.reply: (Giggles.) Hee… hic. Giggle-hic. Giggling makes more.

a.say: Psst. Where should I hide a pretend treasure on my map?

choices.label: Under the tree
choices.reply: Under the tree. (Draws an X.) X for… treasure. Yes.

choices.label: In the teapot
choices.reply: The teapot! Of course. It's always the teapot.

choices.label: In your tail
choices.reply: In my own tail? Then I'm a walking treasure map!

b.say: (Draws a tiny X.) Pretend treasure: hidden. Pretend me: proud.

a.say: (Bubbles drift by.) One bubble. Two bubble. Three…

b.say: Should I pop them or count them?

choices.label: Count them!
choices.reply: Four, five, six… pop. I lost count. Still fun.

choices.label: Pop them!
choices.reply: (Pop! Pop!) Sorry, bubbles! You were very round.

choices.label: @pool:listen
choices.reply: (Holds still.) They're landing on my nose. …Pop. Tickle.

a.say: I put the sock on my paw. Now it's a puppet. Hello!

b.say: What should the sock puppet's name be?

choices.label: Socky
choices.reply: "Hello, I'm Socky." (Sock voice.) Socky likes you.
choices.memory: We named a sock puppet Socky

choices.label: Sir Sock
choices.reply: "Sir Sock, at your service." Very {word:shiny} sock.
choices.memory: We named a sock puppet Sir Sock

choices.label: Snakey
choices.reply: "Ssssocks." Ha! A friendly snake sock.
choices.memory: We named a sock puppet Snakey

c.say: {var:sockName} says goodbye. (The sock bows.) What manners.

a.say: Psst. I'm saving berries. For later. I have three.

b.say: (Counts.) One… two… I have two.

c.say: Where did the third berry go?

choices.label: You ate it!
choices.reply: Did I? (Licks lips.) …Purple. Okay. Probably.

choices.label: The squirrel
choices.reply: The squirrel?! It does like snacks. Fair.

choices.label: Magic!
choices.reply: Magic berry! It went invisible. Into my tummy.

a.say: Ooh. Put your paw near the lantern. Look at the wall.

b.say: What shape should we make?

choices.label: A bunny
choices.reply: (Shadow ears.) A bunny! Hop hop. It's my ears though.

choices.label: A bird
choices.reply: (Flaps paws.) A big bird! Flappy shadow!

choices.label: A Slyte
choices.reply: It's just me. My shadow is a perfect Slyte. Obviously.

a.say: The frogs are singing. Ribbit, ribbit. I want to join.

b.say: Should I sing with them?

choices.label: Sing!
choices.reply: (Yips in rhythm.) Yip-ribbit! Yip-ribbit! We're a band.

choices.label: Just listen
choices.reply: Okay. (Ears forward.) …They're good. Really good.

choices.label: @pool:giggle
choices.reply: You're giggling at my frog face. It's a good frog face.

a.say: Knock knock. …You're supposed to say "who's there."

b.say: Ready? Knock knock.

choices.label: Who's there?
choices.reply: Slyte! …Slyte who? …Just Slyte. I forgot the joke part.

choices.label: @pool:giggle
choices.reply: You laughed before the joke! That's the best kind.

c.say: I'll practice knock-knock jokes. With the door. It's a good listener.

a.say: Psst. Button game. I hide the button in one paw. Which paw?

b.say: Left paw or right paw?

choices.label: Left
choices.reply: (Opens left.) …Empty! Okay, right. Ta-da.

choices.label: Right
choices.reply: (Opens right.) You found it! How?! Your eyes are SO good.

c.say: Button game: the winner is the button. It got held.

a.say: Tap, tap, tap. The rain is drumming on the roof.

b.say: Can we drum back?

choices.label: Yes!
choices.reply: (Taps the floor.) Tap-tap. The rain went tap-tap-tap. Show-off.

choices.label: Just listen
choices.reply: (Lies down.) Rain music. Free concert. Ears on.

choices.label: Sing along
choices.reply: Pitter-patter, Slyte is… flatter? I need better words.

a.say: (Yawns.) Ooh. Big one. Your turn.

b.say: Was your yawn bigger?

choices.label: Way bigger!
choices.reply: Bigger?! I need practice. (Huge yawn.) Ahhh… tie.

choices.label: Smaller
choices.reply: A tiny yawn. Cute yawn. Yawns don't have to be big.

choices.label: @pool:giggle
choices.reply: Giggles don't count as yawns. But they're better.

a.say: Achoo! …Achoo! Two sneezes. Is there a third?

b.say: (Waits.) …(Waits more.) …No third. Two-sneeze day.

c.say: Do you sneeze in twos?

choices.label: Yes, two!
choices.reply: Sneeze twins! Ours match.

choices.label: Just one
choices.reply: Just one. Neat and tidy. Efficient sneezer.

choices.label: @pool:unsure
choices.reply: Count next time. I'll count for you. Achoo— that was mine.

a.say: (Lies flat, nose by the hole.) Hello? Anybody home?

b.say: …A tiny breeze came out. That means someone is breathing. Or it's wind.

c.say: Should we leave a present by the door?

choices.label: A nut
choices.reply: A nut. Very polite. (Places it.) Welcome present.

choices.label: A flower
choices.reply: A flower doorstep. Fancy neighbor stuff.

choices.label: Let them be
choices.reply: Okay. Quiet neighbors like quiet. We'll tiptoe.

a.say: Psst. Help me pick a hiding spot for this nut. A really good one.

b.say: Where should it go?

choices.label: Under the pot
choices.reply: Under the pot. (Tucks it.) Done. I'll forget by lunch.
choices.memory: We hid a nut under the pot

choices.label: In the leaf bed
choices.reply: In my leaf bed! I'll sleep on treasure. Lumpy.
choices.memory: We hid a nut in the leaf bed

choices.label: Under a leaf hat
choices.reply: A leaf hat over a nut. Disguise!
choices.memory: We hid a nut under a leaf hat

c.say: Nut: hidden. Me: proud. Brain: already forgetting.

a.say: (Holds very still.) The ladybug is on my nose. Don't make me laugh.

b.say: Help! What now?

choices.label: Stay still
choices.reply: (Eyes crossed, looking at it.) Staying… staying… it tickles.

choices.label: Blow gently
choices.reply: (Fwoo.) It flew! Bye! You were a nice hat.

choices.label: @pool:giggle
choices.reply: Don't— hee! Hee! (The ladybug flies off.) You made me laugh!

a.say: Psst. Pretend I'm a kite. You hold my tail.

b.say: Should I go up high or low?

choices.label: High!
choices.reply: (Jumps.) Fwip! Up! (Lands.) Very high. For a second.

choices.label: Low
choices.reply: (Wiggles along the ground.) A low kite. A cozy kite.

choices.label: Loop-de-loop
choices.reply: (Spins around.) Loop! Loop! …I'm dizzy. Kite down.

a.say: (Bats a pinecone.) It rolls funny. Wobble-roll.

b.say: Should we roll it down the hill?

choices.label: @pool:yes
choices.reply: (Pushes.) Wobble, wobble, wobble… stopped. Halfway. It liked the view.

choices.label: Keep it
choices.reply: Okay. Pinecone stays. It's on my shelf. Shelf-cone.

a.say: I have a feather. I'm going to tickle my own nose. Science.

b.say: (Tickle tickle.) …Achoo! Science says: sneeze.

c.say: Want to try it on my paw?

choices.label: @pool:yes
choices.reply: (Holds out a paw.) Hee! Hee! Okay stop. No, more.

choices.label: @pool:no
choices.reply: Okay. Feather rests. Good feather.

a.say: Let's pretend to roll down a hill. Ready?

choices.label: Ready!
choices.reply: Wheeee! (Rolls in a circle.) Bottom! I'm at the bottom.

choices.label: Slowly
choices.reply: Slooow roll. (Rolls very slowly.) …Still rolling. Still.

b.say: {pet_phrase} Rolling is the best way to go down. Walking up is the hard part.

a.say: Psst. I checked the twig. The sleeping bag is still there.

b.say: Do you think it's almost done?

choices.label: Almost!
choices.reply: Almost! I'll tiptoe past. Every day. Very quietly.

choices.label: Not yet
choices.reply: Not yet. Okay. Changing takes time. Like growing.

choices.label: It'll be a butterfly
choices.reply: A butterfly. I'll try not to pounce. Gentle Slyte.

a.say: Pretend I have a balloon. A big red one. On a string.

b.say: What should I tie it to?

choices.label: Your tail
choices.reply: (Ties it.) Now my tail floats! I'm a little lighter.

choices.label: The treehouse
choices.reply: The treehouse balloon. Now it looks like a party.

choices.label: The snail
choices.reply: A snail balloon! Now everyone sees it coming. Slowly.

a.say: (Kneads the leaf bed.) Fluff, fluff, fluff. Bed making.

b.say: How many circles before lying down?

choices.label: Three
choices.reply: (Circles three times.) …Perfect. Snug. Very snug.

choices.label: A hundred
choices.reply: A hundred! (Spins and spins.) Ten. Ten is good enough.

a.say: Psst. Tap-tap means hi. Let's practice. (Tap-tap.)

b.say: Can you tap back?

choices.label: Tap-tap!
choices.reply: You said hi in code! Hi back! (Tap-tap.)

choices.label: Tap-tap-tap
choices.reply: Three taps! That means… something new. You invented it.

choices.label: @pool:giggle
choices.reply: A giggle is also code. It means "this is fun."

a.say: (Holds a fluffy dandelion.) One big breath. Then the fluffs fly.

b.say: Ready? You count.

choices.reply: (Fwoooo!) Look at them go! Little sky parachutes!

choices.label: Shh, quiet blow
choices.reply: (Tiny fwoo.) Three fluffs left. They're shy fluffs.

a.say: Chirp. Chirp. A cricket is in the grass somewhere. Somewhere close.

b.say: Should I find it?

choices.label: Find it!
choices.reply: (Creeps.) …Chirp. Over there. (Creeps.) …It moved again!

choices.label: Let it sing
choices.reply: Okay. Let it sing. I'll be the audience. Good chirp.

a.say: Psst. Shadow puppet time. The lantern is on.

b.say: (Two paws up.) Look. A big beak. Clack clack.

c.say: Shadows are very good actors. They do whatever I do.

a.say: Okay okay okay. Puddle hop. One… two…

b.say: Big splash or tiny splash?

choices.label: Big splash!
choices.reply: (SPLOOSH!) …I'm soaked. Worth it.

choices.label: Tiny splash
choices.reply: (Plip.) A polite splash. Hardly wet. Neat.
